verdict.rationale: Twenty's own docs list schedules as a workflow trigger type alongside record changes, manual actions and webhooks. A scheduled trigger is a recurring-schedule capability, not just the one-off Delay step. The workflows it starts can chain record operations, HTTP requests, code, AI Agent and other steps. missing for 10: details of schedule configuration (cron or interval options, frequencies, time zones), explicit confirmation of recurrence semantics, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Trigger workflows on record changes, schedules, manual actions, or incoming webhooks.
Workflows can chain any combination of: Record operations... Send email... HTTP request... Code... Branches... Iterator... AI Agent... Delay... Form
Workflows let you automate repetitive tasks and connect Twenty to external tools
